50% discount on experience transfer

Extra Aid Kit

notes.title: Update 1.1.0.1
notes.notes:
On 10th of March there is going to be a short maintenance session to update game to 1.1.0.1 version, which will last 1-2 hours. Time is a subject to change. Update will be performed starting from 8 AM Moscow time (GMT+3).

Newest additions: 

-         Mass refund for paint covers and devices
-         New devices

-         Removed from sales: Stabilizer, Antiradar, Powerful Antiradar, Consolidation System, Locator, Powerful Locator, Rangefinder, Aimer, Turbo devices.

-         Enhanced turret damage rate in Siege mode
-         Small interface changes

MWO:R Update 1.0.5 - Happy New Year!!
notes.notes:
Update 1.0.5 
Happy New Year!

On 24th of December there is going to be a short maintenance session to update game to 1.0.5 version, which will last 1-2 hours. Time is a subject to change.

Minor updates to graphic interface
Minor collider fixes - improvements and corrections to damage areas display on vehicles
New premium stormtank Boreas
Rebalanced characteristics of vehicle 'Titan' : 
Speed : 72 -> 65
Handleability : 150 ->100
New unique abilities for Phoenix, Beast and Anvil : 
Phoenix now resurrects after death
Beast has a shield that defends from enemy shots
Anvil can stun enemies for a short period of time
Fixed incorrect clan centre functional

New Year promo actions:
From 24th of December to 11th of January: 
New Year decorations for hangar, "Greenland - Fjord Scorserby" and "Australia - Sydney" maps
Available for purchase:
"Holiday Fireworks" supplies
"Triumphant salute" supplies
"Christmas Tree" supply
'Comfort'paint
'Snowflake'paint
'Chip' paint

From 24th of December to 31th of December: 
Paint buyout discount 30%
VIP subscription 30% off
Gold equipment 30% off
Buy 4990 gold - receive 50 000 Super-shots as a gift

From 1st of January to 11th of January: 
Keep an eye in updates, we have prepared some treats for you!
